title: smf configuration
$comment: This schema provides structure, defaults, and conservative editor checks. The smf validate command is authoritative for shell syntax, cross-field rules, and platform-independent path safety.

flavor.description: Optional Flutter flavor selected for every platform build.

target_branch.description: Branch whose commits feed release pull requests.

enabled.description: Enable iOS release planning and delivery.

initial_version.description: Current iOS marketing version used only until the first generated release manifest exists.

bundle_id.description: App Store bundle identifier. Explicit configuration is recommended.

build_command.description: Optional POSIX shell build command. When omitted, smf uses fvm flutter build ipa --release if the project or repository has FVM configuration, and flutter build ipa --release otherwise. Chaining, pipelines, redirections, comments, and command substitution are rejected because smf appends version, build number, export-options, and configured flavor arguments to this invocation.

ipa_output_path.description: IPA file or directory relative to the Flutter app. Override only when a custom build command writes outside Flutter's standard build/ios/ipa directory.

groups.description: Exact existing TestFlight group names that should receive the build.

wait_timeout_minutes.description: Maximum time to wait for Apple build processing.

mode.description: Whether promotion uploads only, submits for review with manual release, or submits for review with automatic release after approval.
